explanation: Searched Mathlib for finite-support and properly-discontinuous action results. Mathlib has `ProperlyDiscontinuousSMul.finite_disjoint_inter_image` in `Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/ConstMulAction.lean`, which gives finiteness of group elements moving one compact set to intersect another. Applying it here also requires the specific implication that nonzero values of `smoothedFundamental` lie in `carrierH` (`mem_carrier_of_ne_zero`); that is not routine glue from the Mathlib declaration, so it does not meet the duplicate or special-case criteria.
